name: s81lk_kp4_dout-t2-COMMIT
purpose: S81 link KP4 decoder tile dout (mask SRAM delay, corrected words, beats) of the 4-tile cluster ot_s81_kp4_dec, 10-17. Bench = cluster equivalence vs 33a35eb7d and the Forney mutant DMUT 2.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_s81_kp4_dout u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS -Irtl/dsrom_sys/s81_link --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_link/ot_s81_kp4_common.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_link/ot_s81_kp4_dout.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/s81lk_kp4_dout/signoff_ffrepair.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/s81lk_kp4_dout/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/s81lk_kp4_dout --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_s81_kp4_dout --macro-view physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w_32x546_m1 > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: S81-TILES2 10-17: four-tile re-split of the KP4 decoder cluster ot_s81_kp4_dec (replaces s81lk_kp4_deca / decb, REJECTED at their CTS gates: 259.2 um tiles, SRAM in the middle, clock on the S face; TT insertion 307-455 / 295-417 ps, spread 148 / 122 ps).  Cluster 2 x 2: dsyn SW (PMA in W), ddly NW, dchn SE, dout NE (beats out E); every seam registered at both pins.  Bit-exact vs the 33a35eb7d two-tile decoder on every output and cycle (tb_s81_kp4_eq: RTL same cycle, hardware view with all tile pin registers = reference + 2 cycles; mutants DMUT 2 / 3 and a one-short word seam FAIL).  dout: the 32 x 546 correction-mask SRAM delay (DC = 9), corrected words straight from the two read ports, fixed-offset beat select; macro at (43.2, 129.6) R0 on the 43.2 lattice against the N face (20.5 um channel), one std-cell band S (127 um) holding every register: all pins below the macro (gate 1 at 248.4 x 146.88 with pins on W / S / E full faces and clk at the E corner measured 3,139 sinks TT 252-370 ps, spread 118 -- a register ring around the macro).  R0 puts the macro read port on its W edge above d_q.  d_q W face below the macro (from ddly, 4.5/um), cw S W half + decision S E half (from dchn), clk / rst_n S centre, q_* E face below the macro (4.9/um).  248.4 x 233.28 (1.06:1).
